title: The basic assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases
prior_knowledge_summary: Assumes mastery of prior prerequisites up to lesson sequence 3.
learning_goals: state the basic assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases

explain how molecular movement causes the pressure exerted by a gas and derive and use the relationship pV = 3 Nm<c2>, where <c2> is the mean-square speed (a simple model considering one-dimensional collisions and then extending to three dimensions using 3 <c2> = <cx2> is sufficient)
